description:
Rewrite the Beadwork parent prompt appendix for goal mode and interactive mode. This issue owns **all** standing prompt copy: review policy, **role vs taskType**, when to pick each task type, child task composition, anti-supervisor language.

## Background

Standing appendix is policy only (does not start a turn). `/bw run` injects a separate go-prompt. Interactive stays human-led.

## Role vs task type (must appear)

- **Role** (open string): how the child works (prompt/template). Same loader as spawn `agent`.
- **Task type** (closed): what question the parent asks when that child settles/fails/aborts/asks. Optional on untyped work.

When to pass `taskType` on `orchestrate`:

- `implementation` — new ticket work. On settle: assess evidence, apply review policy, do not close solely because the child settled.
- `fix` — remediation of a required finding. On settle: re-review before accept.
- `reviewImplementation` — independent ticket review. On settle: disposition **fix | file | reject** (fix blocking; file nonblocking unless user waives a blocker; reject records why). No keyword classifier.
- `reviewScope` — aggregate review before epic complete (scope policy).
- `investigateBlocker` — investigation of blocked work; settlement is not implementation completion.

Untyped research/exploration omits `taskType`.

## Review policy branches

- **ticket (default):** `reviewImplementation` child before close.
- **scope:** may close from evidence; `reviewScope` before epic complete; dependents may start before aggregate review — state that tradeoff.
- **none:** skip independent review children; still judge from Git/bw.

Reviewer children: `git show` / commits / ticket id, not “read the whole dirty workspace”. Do not start review of A while A’s implementer is still live (instruction, not a lock).

Also: start-before-work; compose `task` yourself; domain metadata; quality commands are implementer/reviewer/repo-checkpoint work; no tmux/delegate/worker_done/landing/--workers/polling.

## Files

- `packages/pi-beadwork-extension/src/prompt.ts` only
- unit tests / goldens

## Success criteria

- Appendix contains orchestrate + start-before-work + settlement≠close + all five task types + three review policies.
- Neutral mode undefined appendix.

## Test plan

- Unit: run vs interactive vs neutral.
- Unit: each taskType named with the right next-question.
- Unit: ticket vs scope vs none.
- Goldens so later “simplify the prompt” cannot delete the tradeoff text.
- Log which policy branch was selected.

## Considerations

Do not inject a turn here. 4.1 is goldens only, not a second rewrite. `/bw abandon` is not this file.
